full_prompt_en: A square mixed-media science-fiction illustration presents the upward-looking face of a young woman within a fragmented blue-and-bronze mechanical headpiece on a warm off-white ground. Broad unpainted space surrounds the image, especially at the corners, while the central forms gather into a dense vertical cluster. Her face rises from the lower-left area toward the center, turned slightly to the left and tilted upward. One visible eye looks toward the upper right; the other side of the face is partly swallowed by shadow and overlapping blue forms. The mouth is slightly open, with muted rose-brown lips and a soft highlight along the lower lip. Warm skin tones are modeled across the nose, cheek, and chin with fine speckles and scratch-like marks rather than a perfectly smooth finish. Above the forehead, a blue-gray curved plate follows the hairline and breaks into rough, irregular edges. On the right side of the head, circular metal-like rings, small protrusions, narrow cables, and layered plates accumulate around the ear area. Thin ochre lines trace some of these curves, bringing warm flashes into the cooler structure. Beneath the chin, the dark blue material becomes more abstract: broad smeared brush marks, crosshatched strokes, narrow vertical drips, and scattered flecks taper toward the lower edge. A few long, faint technical-looking lines stand beyond the head on the pale ground, but no text is legible. Some contours are precise around the eye and circular apparatus, while others dissolve into splashes and scratchy marks at the perimeter. The palette stays largely within cold slate blue, charcoal, tarnished gold, and warm flesh color, with the cream ground allowing each dark fragment to read clearly. Soft light touches the forehead, nose, and cheek from the upper left, while deeper shadows collect below the jaw and inside the mechanical recesses. The overall composition is a compact, expressive face emerging from a loose halo of machinery and painterly debris, balancing intimate expression with restless broken texture.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形的科幻混合媒介插画：年轻女子仰望的脸置于破碎的蓝色与铜金色机械头饰之中，背景为暖米白色。画面周围尤其四角保留大片未涂绘空间，中央形体则聚成密集的竖向群组。她的脸从左下方伸向中央，略朝左转并向上仰。一只可见的眼睛望向右上，脸的另一侧部分没入阴影和重叠的蓝色形块。嘴巴微张，唇色是低调的玫瑰褐色，下唇有一道柔和高光。鼻梁、脸颊和下巴的暖肤色以明暗塑形，表面还有细小斑点和划痕般笔迹，并非完全光滑。额头上方，一块蓝灰色弧形板沿着发际延伸，并在外缘破裂成粗糙的不规则形状。头的右侧，环形金属状结构、小突起、细缆线和层叠板片聚集在耳部附近。纤细赭黄色线条顺着部分弧线伸展，为冷色结构加入暖色闪点。下颌以下的深蓝材料变得更抽象：宽阔的擦抹笔痕、交叉排线、细窄竖向滴痕与散落色屑向下缘逐渐消散。浅色背景上，头部之外还有几条细长模糊的技术图样线条，但没有可辨文字。眼睛和圆形装置周围有些轮廓十分准确，另一些轮廓则在边缘消解为泼溅与粗细不齐的划痕。配色主要保持冷石板蓝、炭灰、旧金色与暖肤色，奶油色底让每一块深色碎片清楚可辨。柔光从左上触及额头、鼻梁与脸颊，更深的阴影聚在下颌下方和机械凹处。整体构图是一张紧凑而富有表情的脸，从松散的机械与绘画残屑光环中浮现，在亲密神情和躁动破碎的肌理之间取得平衡。
style_prompt_en: A hybrid painterly illustration combines accurate local modeling with restless, fragmentary marks. Dense blue-gray and charcoal masses gather around a luminous warm center, then break outward into scraped edges, splashes, crosshatching, thin drips, and isolated flecks. Tarnished gold lines thread through the cooler mass, defining small arcs and layered intersections without making the whole surface uniformly metallic. Some focal edges are precise and rounded, while the outer silhouette dissolves into open off-white negative space. Soft directional light brings the pale middle forward, with recessed dark passages giving the layered marks depth. The overall visual effect is energetic and weathered, holding a clear central form inside an unstable field of graphic and painted fragments.
style_prompt_zh: 混合绘画式插画把局部准确的明暗塑形与躁动、碎裂的笔迹结合。密集的蓝灰与炭灰色块围绕明亮暖色中心聚集，再向外裂解为刮擦边缘、泼溅、交叉排线、细滴痕和孤立色屑。旧金色线条穿过较冷的色块，勾出小弧线和层叠交点，却不让整个表面都变成金属质感。一些焦点边缘准确而圆润，外围剪影则消散于敞开的米白负空间。柔和定向光把浅色中央推向前方，凹陷的深色通道赋予层叠笔迹纵深。整体视觉效果充满动势和风化感，清楚的中心形体被不稳定的图形与绘画碎片包围。
theme_en: An upward-looking woman's face emerging from fragmented blue mechanical forms
theme_zh: 女子仰望的脸从破碎的蓝色机械形体中浮现
name: Aleksi Briclot
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
